study: Native phase-polynomial HIR pass with exact Pauli observer pullback
build: Release with CLIFFT_FORCE_ASSERTS=ON and OpenMP enabled

method.compiler: Native HIR passes, planner and executor; no Python sampling rewrite
method.sampling: Median wall time per attempted shot, three alternating repetitions, excluding compilation and warmup
method.postselection: All detectors designated for postselection by the supplied CSV; normalize_syndromes=False
method.selection: 64 random circuits with seed 20261001, supplemented with cases 0005, 0262, 0273, 0300, 0689 and 1037
method.aggregate_speedup: Sum of baseline median seconds per shot divided by sum of native median seconds per shot, estimating an equal-shot run on the 69 sampled circuits
method.width_regression_confirmation: Five alternating repetitions calibrated toward 0.15 seconds per arm, same 200000-shot cap
method.existing_compile_times: Seven paired repetitions after the no-T fast path; throughput from the semantically identical earlier native build
method.timing_limits: Short calibration-based measurements on one host; some expensive baselines have only one shot per repetition

summary.noise_models: Post-T layer: depolarizing on all qubits. Gate Z: independent dephasing on each target after each unitary. Gate depolarizing: 1q or 2q depolarizing after each unitary. Measurements are ideal.

summary.record_reference: Unoptimized native forced-outcome probabilities; unitary state reference is independent Qiskit Aer.

tests.independent_references: Aer statevectors and density-matrix joint records on general/noisy test circuits; Stim for stochastic Clifford cases
